contract_defaults.sign_convention: Positive values increase the named measure; rates and shares use 0 to 1.
contract_defaults.as_of_timing: Selected report period and correction view; snapshots are never summed across time.
contract_defaults.exclusions: Rows outside the approved source contract, failed sources, and ineligible denominators.
contract_defaults.missing_values: Preserve an explicit missing component or suppress the ratio; never coerce missing to zero.
contract_defaults.correction_policy: Support original-publication and latest-known views where M4 version lineage exists; never overwrite source evidence.
contract_defaults.filters: Only approved conformed dimensions; every denominator follows the visible eligible filter context.
contract_defaults.valid_comparisons: Same formula version, population contract, correction view, and comparable source coverage.

supported.public: full row-level publication after product and integrity gates

contract-extension-required.authorized: unavailable until an approved field contract is implemented

external.authorized: absent until a separately approved external source/model is implemented

comparability.population_rule: Natural population movement is descriptive. Compare identical eligible-population contracts and display both denominators.

data_quality.rule: Expose every named quality component. Never average, offset, or hide a failed component.

transition.origin_eligibility: Matched beginning-month loan with positive current UPB and nonmissing days delinquent.
transition.destination_eligibility: Same identity next month with matched status, positive current UPB, and nonmissing days delinquent.
transition.denominator: All eligible beginning-month loans or beginning UPB in the origin state.
transition.attrition: Missing next observation, deletion, termination, nonmatched join, zero balance, or missing delinquency stays in the beginning denominator, is excluded from named transition numerators, and is reported separately.
transition.cure: Beginning state is 30-59, 60-89, or 90+ and next state is Current.
transition.new_delinquency: Beginning state is Current and next state is 30-59, 60-89, or 90+.
transition.redefault: After an observed cure or disclosed modification, first return to 30 or more days delinquent within 12 adjacent monthly periods.
transition.right_censoring: Exclude incomplete 12-month observable windows unless redefault occurs before the window ends; count exclusions separately.

psa.rule: Do not calculate or label PSA until Daily Prepayment Report inputs support approved CPR and the owner separately retains a named convention.

metrics.catalog_label: Expected, received, accepted, excluded, rejected, duplicate, quarantined, and published records
metrics.meaning: Mutually exclusive record dispositions by source family and period.
metrics.supported_decision: Decide whether a release population reconciles.
metrics.formula: Read approved M4 source_manifest counts; expected and received are package counts from approved contracts and manifests.
metrics.numerator: Named disposition or received package count.
metrics.denominator: Expected package count only for completeness components; otherwise none.
metrics.grain: source family, report period, source file
metrics.eligibility: Approved sources with explicit quality status.
metrics.limitation: Supplemental native-grain records remain exclusions from core/loan facts, not rejected rows.

metrics.meaning: Each disposition as a share of physical input rows.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare source processing outcomes without hiding counts.
metrics.formula: disposition_count / physical_input_count
metrics.denominator: Physical input count for the same source scope.
metrics.eligibility: Physical input count greater than zero.
metrics.limitation: A high exclusion rate can be valid when the contract explicitly excludes unlike supplemental grains.

metrics.meaning: Received approved packages compared with period-valid contract expectations.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify missing or retired source families.
metrics.formula: received_required_packages / expected_required_packages
metrics.denominator: Expected required packages after family validity windows.
metrics.eligibility: Periods inside an approved family validity window.
metrics.limitation: File 2 retirement after March 2026 is expected absence, not missing data.

metrics.meaning: Whether every source used an approved period-valid schema and whether a known transition occurred.
metrics.supported_decision: Separate structural change from economic movement.
metrics.formula: all source quality statuses pass and schema_version matches approved period window
metrics.denominator: Received source files.
metrics.eligibility: Received approved source files.
metrics.limitation: April 2026 consolidation is metadata and never an economic event.

metrics.meaning: Reason-coded loan-to-security relationship coverage.
metrics.supported_decision: Determine whether loan analytics use a complete matched population.
metrics.formula: matched_count / sum(all join reason counts)
metrics.denominator: All accepted loan rows with exactly one join reason.
metrics.eligibility: Accepted conformed loan rows.
metrics.limitation: Coverage does not prove business comparability or formula validity.

metrics.meaning: Provider-declared corrected records and UPB plus immutable version replacements when present.
metrics.supported_decision: Assess whether a movement may reflect correction activity.
metrics.formula: count and sum current UPB where correction indicator is not N; separately count changed restatement_lineage rows
metrics.numerator: Corrected record count, corrected current UPB, or changed replacement count.
metrics.denominator: None for volume components.
metrics.eligibility: Accepted conformed records.
metrics.limitation: Provider correction flags and observed replacement versions are reported separately.

metrics.meaning: Acquisition or publication timestamp relative to the reporting date.
metrics.supported_decision: Judge timeliness of the locally acquired release.
metrics.formula: approved acquisition_timestamp - report_period_end; publication lag is separate
metrics.denominator: None.
metrics.eligibility: Source with independently recorded acquisition timestamp.
metrics.limitation: M4 as_of_timestamp is derived from publication date and is not a contracted acquisition timestamp.

metrics.meaning: Pass, warn, or fail across coverage, schema, corrections, population, and metric eligibility.
metrics.supported_decision: Decide whether a period-over-period comparison is usable.
metrics.formula: Apply m5-exact-methodology-v1 precedence: any fail condition is fail; otherwise any warn condition is warn; otherwise pass.
metrics.denominator: Applicable component gates.
metrics.eligibility: All component inputs available under identical formula, population, correction, grain, and source scope.
metrics.limitation: No composite status may hide a failed component; implementation remains gated to its product milestone.

metrics.meaning: Visible named quality controls without a composite score.
metrics.supported_decision: Review each release control without allowing one component to offset another.
metrics.formula: No weighted score. Expose every named component and apply comparability fail-warn-pass precedence.
metrics.denominator: Not applicable.
metrics.eligibility: Every named quality component remains visible.
metrics.limitation: No composite quality score is approved or released.

release_modes.authorized: approved component fixture only; composite unreleased

metrics.meaning: Accepted new issuance volume and unique security population by issue month.
metrics.supported_decision: Monitor issuance scale and mix.
metrics.formula: sum issuance_upb and count accepted unique issuance records
metrics.numerator: Issuance UPB cents or issued-security count.
metrics.denominator: None.
metrics.eligibility: Accepted governed issuance observations.
metrics.limitation: Issuance history currently covers December 2024 through June 2026.

metrics.meaning: Mean and median issuance or current security balance under an explicit context.
metrics.supported_decision: Distinguish volume change from security-size change.
metrics.formula: average = sum UPB / count; median = midpoint of ordered eligible UPB observations
metrics.denominator: Eligible security count for average; ordered observations for median.
metrics.eligibility: Non-null non-negative balance; issuance requires positive issuance UPB.
metrics.limitation: Issuance and current-balance contexts are never mixed.

metrics.meaning: Absolute and percentage change between comparable periods.
metrics.supported_decision: Detect material directional movement.
metrics.formula: absolute = current - prior; percentage = absolute / prior when prior is nonzero and comparison passes
metrics.denominator: Prior comparable measure for percentage change.
metrics.eligibility: Exact prior month, quarter, or year exists and passes comparability inputs.
metrics.limitation: Percentage change is suppressed for zero or missing prior values.

metrics.meaning: Trailing issuance UPB and count over complete monthly windows.
metrics.supported_decision: Separate short-term noise from sustained issuance movement.
metrics.formula: sum monthly issuance over an exact trailing 3, 6, or 12 month window
metrics.denominator: None.
metrics.grain: ending issuance month and window length
metrics.eligibility: Every month in the requested trailing window is present.
metrics.limitation: Incomplete windows are suppressed, not annualized.

metrics.meaning: Issuance count and UPB shares by approved term-family taxonomy, with explicit unmapped population.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify segments driving issuance change.
metrics.formula: segment issuance / visible total; contribution = segment current issuance - comparable prior segment issuance
metrics.denominator: Visible eligible issuance total for shares.
metrics.eligibility: Accepted issuance observations.
metrics.limitation: Term-family grouping does not assert economic equivalence of securities.

metrics.catalog_label: Current outstanding UPB and security/loan count
metrics.meaning: Active end-of-period security and matched loan balance populations.
metrics.supported_decision: Measure the current book without summing snapshots over time.
metrics.formula: sum current UPB and count rows with positive current UPB under each native fact grain
metrics.numerator: Current UPB cents or active row count.
metrics.denominator: None.
metrics.aggregation_class: semi-additive across dimensions; non-additive across time
metrics.eligibility: Positive current balance; security status A; matched loan and correction indicator not D.
metrics.limitation: Security and loan balances are parallel native-grain views and are not added together.

metrics.business_name: New issuance share of ending book
metrics.catalog_label: New issuance as share of ending book
metrics.meaning: Governed issuance flow divided by security ending balance for the same month.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare new production with book size.
metrics.formula: issuance_upb / ending current security UPB
metrics.denominator: Active current security UPB cents for the same report month.
metrics.eligibility: Both source populations cover the same month and denominator is positive.
metrics.limitation: Different source systems are reconciled by period, not by assuming every issuance record appears in the monthly factor file.

metrics.meaning: Mean and median positive current loan UPB for matched active loans.
metrics.supported_decision: Understand whether book changes reflect loan population or size.
metrics.formula: average = sum current loan UPB / active loan count; median requires ordered detail
metrics.denominator: Active matched loan count for average; ordered observations for median.
metrics.grain: loan report period and approved segment
metrics.eligibility: Matched, non-deleted loan with positive current UPB.
metrics.limitation: Streaming engine releases exact average components; exact median is fixture-certified but withheld from full real output until an external-sort resource threshold is approved.

metrics.meaning: UPB-weighted gross, net, issuance, or current rates with context named.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare coupon and borrower-rate composition.
metrics.formula: sum positive current UPB * named milli-percent rate / sum positive current UPB, divided by 1000; security and loan grains remain separate
metrics.numerator: Current UPB cents multiplied by the named milli-percent rate.
metrics.denominator: Current UPB cents for rows with the named rate.
metrics.aggregation_class: non-additive weighted average from additive components
source_lineage: FactLoanPeriod original/issuance/current gross and net rate fields
metrics.grain: security-period or loan-period, rate context explicit
metrics.eligibility: Active positive-balance row with a non-null contracted rate; ARM current-rate not-applicable values remain excluded.
metrics.limitation: Security provider-weighted rates and loan-level portfolio-weighted rates are separate series and are never added or silently blended.

metrics.meaning: UPB-weighted loan age and remaining maturity in months.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare seasoning and remaining-term composition.
metrics.formula: sum current loan UPB * months / sum current loan UPB
metrics.numerator: Current UPB cents multiplied by eligible months.
metrics.denominator: Current UPB cents for rows with the named month field.
metrics.aggregation_class: non-additive weighted average from additive components
metrics.grain: loan report period and approved segment
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan, positive current UPB, non-negative month value.
metrics.limitation: Missing age and maturity denominators remain separate.

metrics.meaning: Provider factor level and same-security change across adjacent comparable months.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify factor movement without labeling it prepayment.
metrics.formula: level = sum current security UPB * factor / eligible UPB; change = sum prior UPB * (current factor - prior factor) / prior UPB for adjacent surviving securities
metrics.denominator: Matching eligible UPB.
metrics.aggregation_class: non-additive weighted average from additive components
metrics.eligibility: Active positive-balance security; change requires same security in immediately prior calendar month with non-null factors.
metrics.limitation: Factor change is descriptive and is not voluntary prepayment, SMM, or CPR.

metrics.meaning: Candidate beginning balance plus supported additions and adjustments less separately supported reductions equals ending balance.
metrics.supported_decision: Explain balance movement before deriving speed metrics.
metrics.formula: beginning + issuance + approved_adjustments - scheduled - curtailment - voluntary - involuntary - terminations = ending + residual
metrics.denominator: None.
metrics.aggregation_class: additive flow components; ending balance semi-additive
metrics.grain: consistent beginning cohort and monthly interval
metrics.eligibility: Every movement component has provider-supported timing and residual is within tolerance.
metrics.limitation: Current M4 fields do not separate scheduled, curtailment, voluntary, issuance, termination, and correction movements.

metrics.business_name: Gross and net paydown or runoff
metrics.meaning: Candidate principal reduction under an approved balance bridge.
metrics.supported_decision: Quantify runoff without mislabeling voluntary behavior.
metrics.formula: approved beginning exposure less approved ending/addition/adjustment components
metrics.denominator: Beginning balance only for a rate.
metrics.grain: consistent beginning cohort and monthly interval
metrics.eligibility: Ending-balance bridge passes and domain reviewer approves treatment.
metrics.limitation: Total balance decline is never called voluntary prepayment.

metrics.meaning: Provider-disclosed involuntary loan removal count and prior-month UPB.
metrics.supported_decision: Separate disclosed involuntary removals from other balance change.
metrics.formula: sum provider-disclosed involuntary removal count and prior-month UPB
metrics.numerator: Removal count or prior-month UPB cents.
metrics.denominator: None.
metrics.eligibility: Non-null provider-disclosed removal component.
metrics.limitation: No voluntary, scheduled, or curtailment inference is made.

metrics.meaning: Provider-disclosed involuntary removals relative to the adjacent prior-month active security population.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare disclosed involuntary-removal intensity across adjacent reporting months.
metrics.formula: current-month involuntary removal count / prior-month active disclosed loan count; current-month prior-month-removal UPB / prior-month active security UPB
metrics.numerator: Provider-disclosed current-month involuntary loan-removal count or prior-month UPB.
metrics.denominator: Adjacent prior-month active disclosed loan count or active security UPB, matched to the numerator basis.
metrics.grain: security portfolio and monthly interval, with original/latest correction views separate
metrics.eligibility: Exact adjacent month exists and the matching prior active population denominator is positive.
metrics.limitation: This is a portfolio prevalence measure, not voluntary prepayment, SMM, CPR, or a cohort speed.

metrics.meaning: Candidate unscheduled principal reduction divided by surviving balance denominator.
metrics.supported_decision: Measure monthly prepayment speed after source and timing approval.
metrics.formula: approved_unscheduled_principal / approved_surviving_balance
metrics.denominator: Approved surviving balance.
metrics.eligibility: Numerator categories, denominator, timing, and correction treatment approved.
metrics.limitation: Monthly M4 balance decline is insufficient to identify voluntary unscheduled principal.

metrics.meaning: Annualized transformation of an approved monthly SMM.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare approved monthly prepayment speeds on an annualized convention.
metrics.denominator: None beyond SMM denominator.
metrics.eligibility: Approved SMM between 0 and 1.
metrics.limitation: CPR is annualized, not forecast, and remains unreleased until SMM approval.

metrics.meaning: Candidate total approved principal reduction relative to beginning balance without voluntary label.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare broad principal runoff after bridge approval.
metrics.formula: approved_total_principal_reduction / approved_beginning_balance
metrics.denominator: Approved beginning balance.
metrics.eligibility: Bridge and denominator approved.
metrics.limitation: The measure is not voluntary prepayment.

metrics.meaning: Approved speed by a fixed, comparable cohort.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify cohorts with different prepayment behavior.
metrics.formula: aggregate approved SMM numerator and denominator within an approved fixed cohort, then derive CPR
metrics.denominator: Cohort approved surviving balance.
metrics.eligibility: Cohort fields, history, and speed formula approved.
metrics.limitation: Current allowlists do not include vintage, coupon, LTV, purpose, or origination fields needed for the full cohort catalog.

metrics.meaning: Approved speed by WALA and prior cumulative paydown for comparable surviving cohorts.
metrics.supported_decision: Assess seasoning patterns without causal inference.
metrics.formula: approved cohort speed grouped by WALA and approved cumulative prior paydown
metrics.denominator: Approved speed denominator.
metrics.grain: fixed cohort, WALA band, and month
metrics.eligibility: Sufficient comparable history and approved speed formula.
metrics.limitation: Current history is short for rate-cycle interpretation and speed remains gated.

metrics.meaning: Separate provider-supported scheduled, curtailment, voluntary, involuntary, termination, issuance, and correction movements.
metrics.supported_decision: Prevent unlike principal movements from being combined.
metrics.formula: report each approved category independently; no residual category is relabeled
metrics.denominator: Approved beginning exposure only for category rates.
metrics.eligibility: Each category has explicit source definition and timing.
metrics.limitation: Only involuntary removal volume is currently source-supported.

release_modes.authorized: candidate fixture plus supported involuntary component; combined measure unreleased

metrics.meaning: Borrower or security rate relative to an approved market mortgage rate.
metrics.supported_decision: Evaluate rate incentive only with separately licensed market data.
metrics.formula: borrower_or_security_rate - approved_market_rate; model response separately
metrics.denominator: None.
metrics.eligibility: External source license, timing, and join approved.
metrics.limitation: No external rate source is approved.

metrics.meaning: CPR expressed relative to a named PSA benchmark convention only after separate retention approval.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare speed with a named market convention when retained.
metrics.formula: No formula retained in m5-exact-methodology-v1.
metrics.denominator: Separately approved PSA benchmark CPR when retained.
metrics.eligibility: DPR-supported CPR and a separately retained PSA convention.
metrics.limitation: PSA is deferred and must not be calculated or labeled.

metrics.meaning: Active matched loan count and UPB in explicit current, 1-29, 30-59, 60-89, 90+, and missing bands.
metrics.supported_decision: Locate disclosed delinquency population shifts.
metrics.formula: sum eligible count and current UPB by deterministic days-delinquent band
metrics.numerator: Band loan count or current UPB cents.
metrics.denominator: None for distribution components; visible total for shares.
metrics.grain: loan report period and delinquency band
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan with non-deleted correction status; missing days remain explicit.
metrics.limitation: Snapshot distribution does not measure transitions or causal credit performance.

metrics.meaning: Threshold count and UPB shares among eligible active loans.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare disclosed delinquency prevalence on a consistent population and basis.
metrics.formula: eligible loans or UPB at/above threshold / eligible non-missing active population
metrics.denominator: Eligible active loan count or UPB with non-missing days delinquent.
metrics.eligibility: Same-as-of matched, non-deleted, positive-UPB loans with non-missing days delinquent.
metrics.limitation: Count and UPB rates are distinct; missing days delinquent is excluded and remains visible in the source distribution.

metrics.meaning: Beginning-cohort transition shares between approved delinquency states.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify disclosed worsening or curing transitions.
metrics.formula: Named adjacent-month transition count or beginning UPB divided by all eligible beginning loans or UPB in the origin state; attrition stays in the denominator and is reported separately.
metrics.numerator: Loans or beginning UPB making the named transition.
metrics.denominator: All eligible beginning-cohort loans or UPB in the origin state.
metrics.grain: loan beginning cohort and adjacent month
metrics.eligibility: Same source-family, loan, and security identity; adjacent complete months; approved correction view; matched positive-balance origin with nonmissing delinquency.
metrics.limitation: Source-family changes break continuity; attrition remains visible and in the beginning denominator.

metrics.meaning: Adjacent-month entry from Current to 30-plus delinquency and first 30-plus return within 12 months after cure or newly disclosed modification status.
metrics.supported_decision: Separate new interval entry into delinquency from repeat distress.
metrics.formula: new delinquency = Current to 30-plus in the next complete month; redefault = first 30-plus return within 12 adjacent months after cure or observed entry into disclosed modification status
metrics.numerator: Named transition count or beginning UPB.
metrics.denominator: Eligible beginning population; redefault uses complete observable 12-month cohorts or earlier observed redefaults.
metrics.eligibility: Complete approved correction-view history; right-censored windows are excluded and counted separately.
metrics.limitation: New means adjacent-interval entry, not first lifetime delinquency. Modification cohorts start only on an observed blank-to-disclosed transition; no historical modification date is inferred.

metrics.meaning: Active loans with a nonblank disclosed modification program.
metrics.supported_decision: Locate disclosed modification-program exposure.
metrics.formula: count active eligible rows where modification_program is nonblank
metrics.denominator: None for volume.
metrics.eligibility: Matched active non-deleted loan.
metrics.limitation: Blank means no disclosed program in the conformed field; capitalized amount is not allowlisted and modification timing is not inferred.

metrics.meaning: Disclosed modification-program population share.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare disclosed modification exposure across reporting periods.
metrics.formula: active loans or UPB with a nonblank disclosed modification program / matching active loan count or UPB
metrics.numerator: Modification-program active loan count or current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Matched, non-deleted, positive-UPB active loan count or current UPB.
metrics.eligibility: Same-as-of matched, non-deleted loans with positive current UPB; count and UPB bases remain separate.
metrics.limitation: Measures disclosed program prevalence, not newly modified loans, modification performance, or causal effect.

metrics.meaning: Current disclosed deferred balance and its share of current loan UPB.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify deferral exposure in the active book.
metrics.formula: sum current deferred UPB; share = sum deferred UPB / sum matching current loan UPB
metrics.denominator: Current loan UPB cents for eligible rows.
metrics.grain: loan report period and approved segment
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan with non-null deferred balance.
metrics.limitation: The source field does not establish cause, assistance success, or future loss.

metrics.business_name: Borrower assistance and alternative resolution share
metrics.meaning: Population with separately disclosed assistance or alternative-resolution indicators.
metrics.supported_decision: Locate assistance-program exposure.
metrics.formula: category loan count or current UPB / visible active loan count or current UPB, with missing explicit
metrics.numerator: Category loan count or current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Matched non-deleted positive-UPB active loan count or current UPB.
metrics.grain: loan report period and named program field
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan; contracted sentinels normalize to explicit missing.
metrics.limitation: Alternative resolution is the latest completed plan and borrower assistance is delayed one servicing month; neither measures effectiveness or a new monthly event.

metrics.business_name: Government guarantee and mortgage insurance share
metrics.meaning: Current balance and count composition by approved guarantee and insurance status.
metrics.supported_decision: Understand disclosed credit-enhancement composition.
metrics.formula: status loan count or current UPB / visible active loan count or current UPB, with missing explicit
metrics.numerator: Status loan count or current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Matched non-deleted positive-UPB active loan count or current UPB.
metrics.grain: loan report period and guarantee or MI status
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan; MI status combines contracted percentage and cancellation fields.
metrics.limitation: Codes describe disclosed coverage category, not guarantee performance, claim likelihood, or credit quality.

metrics.meaning: No provider field in the governed disclosure families isolates delinquent-loan purchases.
metrics.supported_decision: Prevent broad involuntary removals from being mislabeled as delinquent-loan purchases.
metrics.formula: none; do not derive or relabel
metrics.denominator: Unavailable.
source_lineage: involuntary_removal_volume is the broader supported boundary
metrics.eligibility: A future provider source must explicitly isolate delinquent-loan purchases, timing, count, UPB, and corrections.
metrics.limitation: Provider involuntary removals include delinquency, loss mitigation, and lender repurchase; they are not a delinquent-purchase measure.

metrics.business_name: Loss severity, recovery, and realized loss
metrics.catalog_label: Loss severity, recovery, and realized loss
metrics.meaning: Liquidation loss net of recoveries relative to resolved exposure.
metrics.supported_decision: Assess realized credit loss only with governed liquidation and recovery sources.
metrics.formula: (resolved exposure - recoveries) / resolved exposure under approved accounting
metrics.denominator: Resolved exposure.
source_lineage: required liquidation, expense, and recovery sources
metrics.eligibility: External sources, accounting, and joins approved.
metrics.limitation: Current disclosures are insufficient.

metrics.business_name: Weighted and distributional credit score by model
metrics.meaning: Separate legacy credit score, Classic FICO, and VS4 weighted averages and bands, with original and updated contexts separate.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare disclosed credit-score composition without blending models.
metrics.formula: sum current UPB * named score / sum current UPB; band counts and UPB remain separate by score model/context
metrics.numerator: UPB-weighted named score or band count/UPB.
metrics.denominator: Eligible UPB for the same score model and context.
metrics.aggregation_class: weighted average and additive distribution components
metrics.grain: security-period or loan-period, score model, score context
metrics.eligibility: Positive current UPB and exactly one named score field; missing remains explicit.
metrics.limitation: Legacy, Classic FICO, and VS4 are never combined into one score series.

metrics.meaning: Weighted and exact-value collateral-ratio distributions with metric type and timing explicit.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare disclosed leverage composition.
metrics.formula: weighted average = sum positive current UPB * named ratio / matching positive current UPB; exact-value count and UPB shares retain missing explicitly
metrics.numerator: UPB-weighted named ratio or exact-value count/current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Eligible current UPB for the weighted average or visible active population for exact-value shares.
metrics.aggregation_class: weighted average and additive exact-value distribution
metrics.grain: security or loan report period, ratio type, and context kept separate
metrics.eligibility: Active positive-balance row; null, sentinel, and not-applicable values remain explicit missing distribution members and are excluded from weighted averages.
metrics.limitation: Original LTV/CLTV and estimated LTV are distinct contexts. Consumer bands remain a later semantic-model choice, so M5 retains exact values.

metrics.meaning: Current-UPB-weighted disclosed DTI with security and loan grains separate.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare disclosed income-leverage composition.
metrics.formula: sum positive current UPB * disclosed DTI / sum positive current UPB for rows with non-null DTI
metrics.numerator: Current UPB cents multiplied by DTI percent.
metrics.denominator: Current UPB cents for rows with non-null DTI.
metrics.grain: security or loan report period kept separate
metrics.eligibility: Active positive-balance row with contracted non-null DTI.
metrics.limitation: Modified-loan values from June 2018 may use housing debt only; security and loan series are not blended.

metrics.catalog_label: Purpose, occupancy, units, property type, channel
metrics.meaning: Count and UPB composition across disclosed loan and property attributes.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify underwriting and collateral mix shifts.
metrics.formula: category loan count or current UPB / visible active loan count or current UPB, with missing explicit
metrics.numerator: Category loan count or current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Matched non-deleted positive-UPB active loan count or current UPB.
metrics.grain: loan report period and named attribute
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan; contracted sentinels normalize to explicit missing.
metrics.limitation: Categories are provider disclosures and support descriptive composition only; missing and inapplicable values are never inferred.

metrics.meaning: Count or UPB share using the provider-disclosed first-time-homebuyer indicator.
metrics.supported_decision: Describe disclosed borrower composition without borrower judgment.
metrics.formula: Y, N, or explicit missing loan count or current UPB / visible active loan count or current UPB
metrics.numerator: Indicator category loan count or current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Matched non-deleted positive-UPB active loan count or current UPB.
metrics.grain: loan report period and indicator value
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan; provider not-available sentinel remains explicit missing.
metrics.limitation: Provider qualification flag is descriptive and must not support borrower or lending decisions.

metrics.meaning: Active matched loan count and UPB by disclosed property state, with missing explicit.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify geographic exposure shifts.
metrics.formula: state count or current UPB / visible eligible count or UPB total
metrics.numerator: State loan count or current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Visible eligible active loan count or UPB.
metrics.grain: loan report period and property state
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan; blank state maps to explicit missing.
metrics.limitation: Descriptive exposure only; no causal, protected-class, or borrower judgment.

metrics.meaning: Active matched loan count and UPB by disclosed seller or servicer plus top-N and Other components.
metrics.supported_decision: Identify counterparty exposure requiring review.
metrics.formula: entity count or UPB / visible eligible total; top-N sums largest components and Other preserves remainder
metrics.numerator: Entity or top-N loan count/current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Visible eligible active loan count or current UPB.
metrics.grain: loan report period and counterparty type
metrics.eligibility: Matched active loan; blank entity maps to explicit missing.
metrics.limitation: Names and detail remain restricted to authorized local output.

metrics.meaning: Sum of squared visible segment shares for a named population and unit.
metrics.supported_decision: Compare concentration on a consistent population and count or UPB basis.
metrics.formula: sum((segment_component / visible_total)^2)
metrics.denominator: Visible eligible count or UPB total used to form shares.
metrics.grain: report period, dimension, and count/UPB basis
metrics.eligibility: Complete explicit state, seller, or servicer segment population, including missing; total is positive.
metrics.limitation: Count and UPB indexes are distinct and use the visible restricted-local population; HHI is descriptive, not a risk threshold.

metrics.catalog_label: Mission Density Score / Mission Criteria Share
metrics.meaning: Provider-disclosed mission metrics for applicable securities.
metrics.supported_decision: Describe provider-defined mission composition.
metrics.formula: security count or current UPB by exact provider Mission Density Score, Mission Criteria Share, and Mission Index Version / visible active security count or current UPB
metrics.numerator: Exact-value security count or current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Active positive-balance security count or current UPB, with missing explicit.
metrics.unit: securities, cents, score, percent, version, and ratio
metrics.aggregation_class: additive exact-value distribution; provider values are not averaged
metrics.grain: security report period, correction view, and exact provider value
metrics.eligibility: Active positive-balance security; contracted unavailable and not-applicable values remain explicit missing.
metrics.limitation: Provider mission values are preserved as distributions, not averaged or treated as impact, causal, or credit-risk measures.

metrics.meaning: Provider-disclosed flags summarized descriptively.
metrics.supported_decision: Describe flagged program composition without impact claims.
metrics.formula: flag category count or current UPB / visible active population at the same native security or loan grain, with missing explicit
metrics.numerator: Flag category count or current UPB.
metrics.denominator: Active positive-balance security or matched active loan count/current UPB at the same native grain.
metrics.grain: security or loan report period and named flag, never combined across grains
metrics.eligibility: Active positive-balance row; contracted sentinel and not-applicable values remain explicit missing.
metrics.limitation: Flags are descriptive provider classifications only; no impact, causality, benefit, or borrower claim is made.

metrics.business_name: Market, valuation, risk, and macro metrics
metrics.catalog_label: Price, yield, return, OAS, spreads, duration, convexity, WAL, hedge, TBA roll, MSR, benchmark, HPI, unemployment, and causal metrics
metrics.meaning: Metrics requiring licensed market, cash-flow, benchmark, valuation, servicing, or macroeconomic sources and models.
metrics.supported_decision: Keep unsupported market and causal claims outside the disclosure product.
metrics.formula: Defined only after separate source/model contract and approval.
metrics.denominator: External source/model dependent.
source_lineage: required separately licensed external sources and governed models
metrics.eligibility: Source rights, model validation, timing, joins, and release approval complete.
metrics.limitation: Never simulated, inferred, zero-filled, or presented from current disclosure fields.
